name: GitHub Usability and Release Candidate

entry_contract.formal_delivery_rule: Gate 3, passing shared contract validation, no Hard Stop or render blocker, and passing independent validation are all required before user-ready rendering.
entry_contract.lower_gate_behavior: Preserve the shared contract and analyst-input template, emit a machine-readable diagnostic, and withhold formal user-ready reports.
entry_contract.private_input_behavior: Reject Gate 4 portfolio, holdings, exposure, sizing, action, and approval fields before builder execution without logging their values.
entry_contract.renderer_role: Formatting only; the entry point does not recalculate accounting, valuation, scenario, or investment conclusions.

environment_and_dependencies.old_python_behavior: Python 3.9 returns an actionable diagnostic instead of importing the analytical engine.

scope_boundary: S16 does not change issuer accounting, evidence, valuation, scenario, Gate 4, or monitoring calculations.
S16 does not accept private portfolio inputs through the public ticker command.
S16 does not publish this branch, create a GitHub release, or move main.
S16 does not select or run the S17 true held-out company.
The final release remains blocked until S17 code freeze, held-out acceptance, full regression, PDF QA, privacy scan, and contract validation are complete.
